# Assignment 2

```{r}
species <- read.csv("Datasets/species.csv")

species$pH <- as.factor(species$pH)

species.full <- glm(Species ~ pH + Biomass,
                    family = poisson(link = "log"),
                    data = species)

summary(species.full)

species.pH <- glm(Species ~ pH,
                  family = poisson(link = "log"),
                  data = species)

species.biomass <- glm(Species ~ Biomass,
                       family = poisson(link = "log"),
                       data = species)

species.null <- glm(Species ~ 1,
                    family = poisson(link = "log"),
                    data = species)

AIC(species.full,
    species.pH,
    species.biomass,
    species.null)

anova(species.full, test = "Chisq")

species.best <- step(species.full)

summary(species.best)
```

# Assignment 3

```{r}
bolger <- read.csv("Datasets/bolger.csv")

bolger.full <- glm(RODENTSP ~ PERSHRUB + DISTX + AGE,
                   family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                   data = bolger)

summary(bolger.full)

bolger.shrub <- glm(RODENTSP ~ PERSHRUB,
                    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                    data = bolger)

bolger.distance <- glm(RODENTSP ~ DISTX,
                       family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                       data = bolger)

bolger.age <- glm(RODENTSP ~ AGE,
                  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                  data = bolger)

bolger.null <- glm(RODENTSP ~ 1,
                   family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                   data = bolger)

AIC(bolger.full,
    bolger.shrub,
    bolger.distance,
    bolger.age,
    bolger.null)

anova(bolger.full, test = "Chisq")

bolger.best <- step(bolger.full)

summary(bolger.best)
```

# Assignment 4

```{r}
molerat <- read.csv("Datasets/molerat.csv")

molerat$caste <- as.factor(molerat$caste)

molerat.full <- glm(lnenergy ~ lnmass + caste,
                    family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                    data = molerat)

summary(molerat.full)

molerat.mass <- glm(lnenergy ~ lnmass,
                    family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                    data = molerat)

molerat.caste <- glm(lnenergy ~ caste,
                     family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                     data = molerat)

molerat.null <- glm(lnenergy ~ 1,
                    family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                    data = molerat)

AIC(molerat.full,
    molerat.mass,
    molerat.caste,
    molerat.null)

anova(molerat.full, test = "F")

molerat.best <- step(molerat.full)

summary(molerat.best)
```
